summary: A Toronto med spa founded in 2024 appears to lose bookings to dead menu items and an empty results section.

findings.problem: Eight menu items, including Services, Potenza and Laser, appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Patients exploring treatments cannot get to them.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The phone link appears to be written tel:\(647\) 288-0278 with escaped characters.
findings.cost: Mobile visitors tapping to call may get nothing.

findings.problem: The See Our Clients Transformations section appears to show only Button labels and no results.
findings.cost: Med spa patients buy on visible results.
findings.fix: Real consented before and after photos.

findings.problem: No practitioner names, credentials or reviews appear, and Skin Tightening appears under three different page addresses.
findings.cost: Patients want to know who treats them, and duplicate pages weaken search ranking.
findings.fix: Practitioner profiles, reviews and one page per treatment.
